column1: # Portal 2 on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# Source engine (Switch: NVIDIA Lightspeed port), SDK 13, base game 1.0.3. The first SDK 13 OpenGL title met: subsdk0 is GLSLC,
# the game's own runtime shader compiler, and the game files hold no shader files at all. Modules are main subsdk0 sdk
# (subsdk1, NintendoSDK_OpenGL, stays out: the host's GL layer takes the game's GL calls).
# Plays: the title, the menus, a new save and chapter 1 were played on Android; later chapters are untested and a newly
# reached area can compile a shader variant the bundle lacks: it is captured on the device and must be translated back into the
# A Switch save whose config.cfg holds mat_monitorgamma_nx_docked hangs the main menu on the LOADING screen; deleting that line
# (and mat_monitorgamma_nx_handheld) lets it enter. The port's own new save may write nx_docked again.
# Tested 2026-11-19 on the Y700: 60 fps, footprint about 520 MiB, zero skipped draws after the capture rounds (10 -> 64 -> 138).

column2: 1.0.3 Lenovo Legion Y700 TB323FU (Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5, Adreno 840, Android 16)
